title: Fudge on the Bridge
lines: Meg and Dad made a big box of fudge.
Meg must take it to Gran past the bridge.
A big duck sits on the bridge.
Meg waves a hat and yells at it.
The duck just sits and blinks at Meg.
Then the duck licks the side of the box.
Meg sets a bit of fudge on the edge.
The duck hops up and licks it up.
Meg runs past and hands Gran the box.
Gran grins and pins a badge on Meg.

questions.ask: What was sitting on the bridge?
questions.listenFor: A big duck. Stated in the story - point them at that line rather than saying it for them.

questions.ask: What did Meg do to get the duck to move?
questions.listenFor: She set a bit of fudge on the edge, and the duck hopped over to lick it. If they say "she yelled," ask "did that work?"

questions.ask: What do you think Gran did with the rest of the fudge? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer. Listen for a reason - shared it, saved it, ate it with Meg.
